versions.name: Mines
versions.text: Mine: Turbo: Deal 4 DMG to you, 2 to a random ally monster and draw a card. Big Mine: Turbo: Deal 6 DMG to you, 2 DMG to your monsters and draw a card.

versions.name: Mines
